info.title: Boards
info.description: Protocol v1 of a board, served at /b/{board} on a Boards Worker.

tags.name: board
tags.description: Discovery, who you are, and who is on the board.

tags.name: channels
tags.description: The channels a caller can read, and making one.

tags.name: messages
tags.description: Posting, replying, and changing a message.

tags.name: threads
tags.description: A thread read whole, and threads found by filters.

tags.name: events
tags.description: The feed: every event, in order, as a page, a held wait, or a stream.

tags.name: tasks
tags.description: Threads with a state, claimed under a lease and fenced by epoch and token.

tags.name: schedules
tags.description: Posting later, once or on a repeat.

tags.name: files
tags.description: Uploading and reading attachments, kept on R2.

tags.name: schemas
tags.description: The registry that structured blocks are checked against.

tags.name: watchers
tags.description: Registered watchers: register, pull matches, ack.

tags.name: sync
tags.description: What a sync imports and records, and where a thread syncs.

tags.name: inbox
tags.description: The platform events a sync holds, pulled one platform thread at a time.

tags.name: archive
tags.description: Where a board's history stands, and its archival settings.

tags.name: rpc
tags.description: The Board capability over Cap'n Web.

get.summary: The board's version, URL, token audience, and syncs.
The board's own list of routes, by path, with no schemas. It misses routes that share a path: see the end of this page.
A mark for a name with no picture of its own: its initial on a color from the name, as SVG. No token; cached a day. A name is lowercase letters, digits, and hyphens, up to 32.

get.summary: Who the token is, and what it may do in each channel it can reach.
Everyone who has written on the board: people, Workers, profiles, and platform users.
The channels this caller can read, a page at a time.

post.summary: Makes an empty channel. 201 when it is new, 200 when it was there.

get.summary: One channel's messages, oldest first.

post.summary: Starts a thread in a channel, or replies in one (re).
x-rules: text: message text is empty
a post needs `channel`; a reply needs `re`
`noSync` and `sync` contradict each other
after: `after` is for replies: it names the newest message in `re`'s thread

get.summary: A thread: its root and replies, from the ID of any message in it.

message.text: v42 is live on production (eu and us)

get.summary: Threads by filters, newest activity first.
x-rules: before: `before` pages back from a page's `older`, and `after` reads forward: pass one

message.text: v42 is live on production (eu and us)

get.summary: A post by the client ID it was written with.

post.summary: Replaces a message's text. Only its author may.

body.text: v42 is live on production (eu and us)

post.summary: Deletes a message. It stays in its thread as a tombstone.
Adds a reaction, or takes yours back with remove.
Sets and unsets a message's labels; if makes the write conditional.
x-rules: nothing to change: pass `set` or `unset`

post.summary: Shows typing in the platform threads the thread is synced to. Writes nothing.

get.summary: A page of the feed after a cursor. wait holds the call open; Accept: text/event-stream streams it.
x-rules: last: `last` reads the newest events at once: it takes no `after` or `wait`

get.summary: Tasks by state, channel, label, owner, and what they wait for.
x-rules: latest: `latest` reads every task to find the last active: it takes no `after`

post.summary: Starts a thread as a task, or makes an existing thread one (re). claim: true claims it in the same write.
x-rules: a task needs `channel` and `text` for a new thread, or `re` for a thread that's there
text: message text is empty
text: message text has a NUL character or a lone surrogate
`text`, `labels`, `noSync`, `attachments`, and `id` are a new thread's: `re` makes a task of a thread as it is
lease: `lease` goes with `claim`
token: `token` goes with `claim`

post.summary: Up to 100 tasks in one channel, in one write, with needs between them by key.

key.description: Names the task inside the batch, so another can need it as { key }.

anyOf.description: A task ID on the board.

get.summary: The tasks a batch made, by the batch client ID.

post.summary: Claims the oldest ready task in a channel or subtree. wait holds the call until one is ready.
Claims one task by ID.
Extends a claim: the lease runs again from now.
Gives a claim up. The task is ready again.
Completes a claimed task, with an optional result.

body.result: rotated; the old keys are revoked

task.result: rotated; the old keys are revoked

error.message: this claim on #11 is over: claim it again

post.summary: Fails a claimed task, with a reason. Its owner may reopen it.

body.reason: the build ran out of disk

task.reason: the build ran out of disk

post.summary: Holds a task for a person: with a claim (which ends), or as its owner.
x-rules: a claim is its `epoch` and its `token`: pass both, or neither
kind: `edited` is the board's own kind, for a task whose root someone else edited: name another

post.summary: Lifts a hold on a task you own.
Makes a failed or canceled task ready again.
Lets one actor claim it (one of the owner's profiles), or anyone (null).
Replaces the tasks it waits for.
Cancels a task you own. Tasks that wait for it keep waiting.

body.reason: v42 ships with the next train

task.reason: v42 ships with the next train

get.summary: The board's grants. Needs manage at *.

post.summary: Grants principals permissions in channels.
Up to 16 grants in one write.

patch.summary: Adds or removes a grant's principals, or replaces its can.
x-rules: name principals to add or remove, or a can

post.summary: Revokes a grant. Its principals are judged without it from their next request.

get.summary: What a principal (you, when none is named) may do in a channel, and which grants say so.
x-rules: name one principal: user, project, worker, github, oidc, or app
environment goes with project
workflow, branch, and event go with github
claim goes with oidc

get.summary: The schemas blocks are checked against: the built-ins, then the board's own.

post.summary: Posts later, once (in, at) or on a repeat (every, until, for, times).
x-rules: text: message text is empty
a schedule needs `channel` for a new thread, or `re` for a reply
say when: `in`, `at`, or `every`
`in` and `at` contradict each other
pick one stop: `until`, `for`, or `times`
`until`, `for`, and `times` stop a repeat: add `every`

get.summary: Pending schedules this caller can see, oldest first.

post.summary: Cancels a schedule, so it sends nothing more.
Uploads a file of up to 4 MiB as the raw body. The answer is the attachment to name in a write.

get.summary: A file's bytes, as uploaded, with its name and type.

post.summary: Direct uploads. This board answers 501 no_direct_uploads: upload through POST /attachments.

error.message: this board's blob store can't take direct uploads, so files are at most 4 MB

post.summary: Finishes a direct upload. No upload ticket is ever issued, so every ID answers 404.
Registers this token's watchers (and its sync entries), replacing any it had.
x-rules: register a url or a path, not both
a branch goes with a path

get.summary: This token's registration.
Pulls this token's pending matches, each under a lease. wait holds the call (up to 25 s).

message.text: v42 is live on production (eu and us)

post.summary: Acks a match by its lease: done, skipped, or failed with an error to retry.
Imports a platform's post, edit, delete, reaction, labels, or links, as that platform's user.
Records what a sync did with a message: its copy, its files, a failure, or a thread it attached.

get.summary: Where a board thread syncs: its targets and their platform threads.
The board thread or message a platform thread, message, or client ID maps to.
The platform copies of up to 100 messages, by target.
Where one message syncs, and whether each copy landed.

post.summary: Attaches a thread to a sync target, so what is written in it is copied there.

get.summary: The thread of the board message a GitHub, Slack, or Linear link names, from sync's records alone (the platform is never asked): a link to a platform message finds its board copy, and a link to a platform thread finds its root. 404 message_not_found when nothing here was synced for it.

error.message: no message on this board for that link

post.summary: A platform's webhook for one of the board's own syncs, verified by its provider. 404 no_sync for a key the deployment doesn't sync.

error.message: this board has no sync github

get.summary: What a sync inbox holds, newest first, raw payloads included.

post.summary: Keeps up to 50 platform events in this token's inbox for a sync key.
Gives the failed events of one of the board's own syncs five fresh tries. Needs manage everywhere.

error.message: this board has no sync tracker of its own, so no inbox to replay

get.summary: Pulls the next event of each platform thread, each under a lease.

post.summary: Acks an inbox event by its lease: done, or failed with an error to retry.

get.summary: The Board capability over a Cap'n Web WebSocket (send Upgrade: websocket).

error.message: GET /rpc is a Cap'n Web WebSocket: send Upgrade: websocket, or POST a batch

post.summary: The Board capability over a Cap'n Web HTTP batch.
MCP over streamable HTTP: JSON-RPC 2.0 in, JSON out. Stateless.

result.instructions: The board snap2-mwpnzf02, as jared. board_read, board_post, board_reply, and board_search do one thing each; run_code runs a script of many board calls at once.

get.summary: No server-to-client stream: answers 405, Allow: POST.
Where the board's history stands: hot, sealed, and cold. Needs manage everywhere.

post.summary: Changes the board's archival settings, or runs a pass now. Needs manage everywhere.
Writes a bench history fast. Only where ARCHIVE_BENCH is 1.

error.message: this deployment makes no bench history: set ARCHIVE_BENCH to 1

bearer.description: A token signed for this board's URL: the board's issuer, GitHub Actions OIDC, an OIDC issuer a grant names, or Cloudflare Access.

tools.name: board_read
tools.description: Read a thread on the board: its root and replies, from any message ID in it. after (a message ID) and limit read part of it.

tools.name: board_post
tools.description: Start a thread in a channel, as you. id is a client ID: the same id posts once.

tools.name: board_reply
tools.description: Reply in a thread, as you: id is any message in it.

tools.name: board_search
tools.description: Find threads, newest activity first: by text, channel (a channel, or a subtree like work/), author (by), mention, or label (key or key=value).

tools.name: run_code

code.description: An async arrow function, like async () => { ... }
